abort.missing_prerequisites: Install and set up pyscript and the Rachio integration first, then add this integration.
abort.single_instance_allowed: GeoDrops + Rachio Irrigation is already configured.

bindings.title: Core Setup
bindings.description: Point the scheduler at your notification, calendar, Rachio controller, and forecast entities.

data_description.rachio_device_name: The exact device name of your Rachio controller (Rachio app → Settings → Devices).
data_description.rachio_api_key_secret: The key NAME in secrets.yaml that holds your Rachio API key — not the key value itself.
data_description.standby_switch: Your Rachio controller's standby switch; the scheduler mirrors it to suspend watering.
data_description.forecast_entity: A weather.* entity providing an hourly forecast (used for rain-skip and overnight forecast means).

weather.title: Weather Station
weather.description: Your local weather-station sensors, plus the sensor-name prefixes for hourly precipitation forecasts.

data_description.precipitation_chance_prefix: Prefix of your hourly forecast precip-chance sensors; the scheduler appends an hour count, e.g. sensor.precipitation_chance_3_hour.
data_description.precipitation_amount_prefix: Prefix of your hourly forecast precip-amount sensors; the scheduler appends an hour count, e.g. sensor.precipitation_amount_3_hour.

zone_gate.title: Zones
zone_gate.description: Your existing zones are kept as-is. Choose whether to add another zone.

zone.title: Add a Zone
zone.description: Define one Rachio zone: its switch, its GeoDrops moisture sensors, and how much water a full refill needs.

data.add_another_zone: Add another zone after this one

data_description.key: A short identifier for this zone, e.g. front_lawn. Used as the zone's config key and shown in logs.
data_description.target_range: The GeoDrops moisture band the scheduler keeps this zone at.
data_description.geography: A free-text label to group zones for your own organization (e.g. front, back). Not used by the scheduler's logic.
data_description.adjacency: Other zones physically next to this one; the scheduler avoids watering neighbors back-to-back to limit runoff.
data_description.runtime_minutes: Minutes for a full refill of this zone — use the Rachio app's computed zone runtime.
data_description.refill_depth_mm: Full-refill depth in mm — Rachio's depthOfWater (inches) × 25.4.
data_description.spray: Enable if this zone's spray can reach your weather station. The scheduler then confirms 'rain' with the physical rain gauge instead of trusting the reported precipitation type while this zone is running.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Active Watering Calibration is Beta and off by default.

data_description.self_calibration_enabled: When on, each zone learns its own dosing from soil-moisture response. Beta — leave off until you've watched it run.
data_description.advanced_overrides: Optional YAML mapping merged into tunables for advanced tuning. Leave blank unless you know what you're changing.
